result.quote: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
result.reason: Verse 26:4 explicitly identifies doing what was right as the way Uzziah followed Amaziah’s example; seeking God is not said to be an example inherited from his father. Thus the revised key is uniquely supported by the window. However, the source pair intended a two-part answer—doing right and seeking God—so the edit narrows the original answer scope.
